## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] New logic has tests
- [ ] UI changes were verified in a real browser, not only in unit tests
- [ ] No secrets committed
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] Commits are scoped

Screenshots or a short clip help reviewers for UI changes.
